title: PhD Completion Forecast Simulator
instructions: Enter your start date and, if needed, switch to advanced mode to set a different current date.
Use the Average prolongation tab to estimate milestones using one overall future prolongation percentage.
Use the Semester prolongation tab if you want to enter different prolongation values for each semester.
Choose between Timeline view and Activity view depending on whether you want dates along a timeline or activity percentage milestones.
Enable comparison mode in advanced settings if you want to compare two prolongation scenarios.
Check the Milestones and Statistics panels below the plot for the calculated output.
Open the Changelog tab to see what has changed in the app over time.
about: This app was created for doctoral students at the Department of Food Studies, Nutrition, and Dietetics.
The goal is to (unofficially) calculate doctoral completion timing based on your current progress and expected future prolongation.
It supports both an average prolongation model and a semester-specific model, with timeline and activity views.
Source code and more information are available on GitHub.
If you find a bug or have a feature request, please open an issue in the GitHub repository.
